law: A measured disagreement is attributed here, never inferred in code. Absent from this file means UNADJUDICATED, which is a QUEUE and not a pass. Every attribution carries the measurement that forced it and the crossed control that ruled out the alternative -- an equal count against no control proves nothing.

fault_vocabulary.SUPERTABLE_GAP: the source holds values on keys where we hold nothing; once the key plane is receipted this cannot be a mapping fault
fault_vocabulary.SUPERTABLE_VALUE: we hold a value and it is wrong; concentrated and/or one-sided
fault_vocabulary.SOURCE_DEFECT: we are right and the source is the outlier
fault_vocabulary.NAME_COLLISION: two different statistics share a name; the mapping is withdrawn, not repaired
fault_vocabulary.MAPPING_DEFECT: the value path itself is wrong -- unit, filter, grain, or the wrong physical column

why_this_file_exists: The verdict vocabulary had five values and four of them blamed our plumbing. There was no sentence for 'the value path is right and OUR NUMBER is wrong', so a disagreement could never convict the supertable and the repair queue could never be populated. Worse, the one failing verdict also DE-LICENSED the witness, so the more wrong our data was the fewer witnesses were allowed to speak about it.

adjudications.basis: The site's DEF block renders TKL|AST|COMBINED|SOLO at positions 4,5,6,7. The internal identity COMBINED = TKL + AST holds on 100.00% of 53,451 four-column-complete rows, every season 1950-2025. The competing form COMBINED = SOLO + AST holds on 54.04%. The margin is the receipt: position 4 (TKL) is the site's unassisted-tackle total and position 6 (COMBINED) is the sum, so position 7 (SOLO) is NOT solo tackles and our mapping is on the wrong physical column.
adjudications.crossed_control: Against the supertable on 49,669 deduplicated player-seasons, nflcom TKL reads 73.28% vs def_tackles_solo and nflcom SOLO reads 52.48%. On the 2010+ stratum where tackles are reliably recorded (18,024 player-seasons) the separation is decisive: TKL 95.7%, SOLO 60.9%.
adjudications.measurement_hazard: The source carries 3,304 exact duplicate rows (3.6%). Summing over them depressed TKL's measured agreement from 73.28% to 47.59% -- a 26-point artefact that would have read as 'weak overlap, mapping is wrong' for the CORRECT column. Any re-measurement must SELECT DISTINCT before aggregating.
adjudications.settles: docs/nflcom-column-semantics.json KNOWN_LABEL_QUESTIONS: 'which of TKL/COMBINED is the site's total is a label question the layout test cannot settle'. It is COMBINED; TKL is the solo count.
adjudications.remedy: withdraw solo -> def_tackles_solo; adjudicate tkl (currently OPEN) -> def_tackles_solo
adjudications.remedy_note: solo withdrawn to OPEN (identity unknown, not merely wrong); tkl adjudicated to def_tackles_solo. Both halves of the remedy applied together -- doing only the second would have left two specs from one table on the same canonical

adjudications.basis: THE EMPTY STRING IS NOT A NULL. NFL.com writes '' where a column does not apply to a row -- the Defense Career table renders a 58.3% tackle block and a 17.8% interception block into ONE physical schema and blanks the half that does not apply. COUNT(col) counts '', so the audit reported occupancy=1.0000 for all 21 Defense Career columns while true publication ran 15.9% (opp_fr) to 100% (g). The read filter `col IS NOT NULL` PASSED those rows; SUM(TRY_CAST('' AS DOUBLE)) is NULL; ABS(NULL-vv)<=1 is NULL -- so every row the source did not publish was scored as a DISAGREEMENT against us.
adjudications.crossed_control: opp_fr read 46.86% because NFL.com publishes it on 6 of 15,772 rows in 2000-09 and the other 15,766 were counted against us; restricted to published rows it reads 99.28% on the 2010+ stratum. Control in the other direction: `g` and `gs` are 100% numeric, and their measured values did not move at all when the filter changed. 107 of 145 column-instances in this source carry the placeholder.
adjudications.measurement_hazard: This defect FLATTERS NOTHING and therefore hid: it depressed agreement, so every affected column looked like an honest weak mapping rather than a broken measurement. Three separate columns (xblk, blk, punts_blocked) were sitting at 27-60% blended while reading 99.1-100.0% on their own modern stratum.
adjudications.settles: The `occupancy` field of every pre-2026-07-31 row of nflcom_column_audit.json is void. `published_share` replaces it and `notnull_share` is kept beside it so the gap is visible rather than inferred.
adjudications.remedy: nflcom_column_audit.published() filters on TRY_CAST, not on IS NOT NULL; occupancy replaced by published_share/notnull_share
adjudications.remedy_note: Guarded by test_nflcom_column_audit.py on SYNTHETIC fixtures, so the guard survives the fix rather than dying with it.

adjudications.basis: AN ABSOLUTE +/-1 BAND IS NOT A TOLERANCE ON A COUNT WHOSE MEDIAN IS 1 -- it accepts {0,1,2}, i.e. every value the statistic takes. `sfty` scored 71.39% under the band and 35.54% under equality, and 143 of the 143 rows it 'agreed' on in 1982-93 were src=1 against our 0: a total contradiction reported as agreement.
adjudications.crossed_control: The band's effect is not uniform, which is how it escaped notice: it moves ff by 14.97 points (82.62 -> 97.59) and int by 0.44 (99.48 -> 99.92). A column already near 100 barely moves, so spot checks on the clean columns showed nothing.
adjudications.settles: agree_pct is now EQUALITY. The band is retained as agree_pct_pm1 beside it so the two can be compared rather than one silently standing in for the other.
adjudications.remedy: exact match is the headline metric; agree_pct_pm1 recorded alongside

adjudications.basis: THREE-LINEAGE MEASUREMENT RUN, on one common base of 45,679 (pfr_id, season) present in all of nflcom DEF_career, pfr_player_defense and v26. TWO RESULTS, one settled and one not. SETTLED -- the internal identity is self-contained and needs no independence assumption: COMBINED = TKL + AST holds on 100.0% of the common base while COMBINED = SOLO + AST holds on 50.0%, and PFR and v26 each satisfy their own combined = solo + ast at 100.0%. NOT SETTLED -- the VALUE disagreement. On the 2010+ stratum: nflcom~pfr 88.1%, nflcom~v26 89.0%, pfr~v26 98.6% (exact match, published rows only). NFL.com is the outlier of the three, but see the licence note.
adjudications.crossed_control: Postseason was tested and REFUTED as the explanation: nflcom tkl matches v26 REG at 86.3% and REG+POST at 67.4%, so the residual is not playoff rows. Magnitude: median absolute difference is 1 tackle, 2,046 rows nflcom-high against 352 us-high, and 95.5% of the 2010+ base agrees within a 2% relative tolerance.
adjudications.measurement_hazard: LICENCE, not arithmetic, is what blocks the attribution. lineage_roots.v1.json declares that pfr, nflverse_pbp AND nflcom box-count families share the elias_gsis_gamebook ancestor with status DECLARED_UNRECEIPTED and voting_effect 'none'. v26's tackles are nflverse-descended for 1999+ and PBP-derived for 1978-98 (build_pbp_idp_backfill_v26). So 'two lineages agreeing against the third' is NOT a licensed receipt for this family -- the agreement may be inherited from one primal record. This is exactly OQ-LR-1, which is QUEUED.
adjudications.settles: Nothing may be attributed to SOURCE_DEFECT or SUPERTABLE_VALUE on the tackle VALUES until OQ-LR-1 is receipted. What IS settled is that the supertable is not the odd one out, which refutes the hypothesis recorded in queued_questions.
adjudications.remedy: none applied; escalated to OQ-LR-1 in lineage_roots.v1.json
adjudications.era_floor: Pre-2000 no pair of the three agrees: pfr~v26 solo reads 24.2% (1994-99) and 0.6% (1982-93). Tackles are not an arbitrable statistic in ANY of these lineages before ~2000 and no mapping verdict may be drawn there.

adjudications.basis: AUDIT CAPACITY IN AN EXCLUDED COLUMN. `avg` is correctly EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON from the SCHEMA (a derived ratio whose operands we already store) and wrongly excluded from the AUDIT. The identity avg == yds / int holds on 99.98% of 15,251 single-row player-seasons. Substituting OUR operands, v26.def_interception_yards / v26.def_interceptions reproduces the source's published avg on 99.44% of 15,232 -- one equation auditing BOTH canonicals at once.
adjudications.crossed_control: avg == yds / g reads 15.65% on the same rows. The 84-point margin is the receipt that the denominator is interceptions and not games.
adjudications.settles: Generalises the y/c argument to this table: 'not a supertable column' and 'cannot audit a supertable column' are different claims, and the dossier disposition answers only the first.
adjudications.remedy: none applied -- column_dispositions.v1.json has no vocabulary for 'excluded from schema, retained for audit'. Adding one is a contract change with gate consequences and is escalated rather than improvised.

adjudications.basis: The audit route for `g`/`gs` exists but its TARGET does not. The v26 release carries no games column at all -- no games_played, no games_started, no games; the only game-ish physical columns are game_date, game_margin and a merge-stamp. stat_contracts declares games_played (unit=games, EVENT_CARDINALITY) and games_started (FIRST), so the canonicals are contracted but unrealised in the release.
adjudications.crossed_control: COUNT(DISTINCT REG week) is the obvious proxy and is NOT games played: it reads 93.2% against nflcom `g` on 2010+ but 54.4% (2000-09) and 51.1% (<2000), because a weekly row records roster presence rather than participation. Using it would have manufactured a 51% 'disagreement' out of our own proxy.
adjudications.settles: The dossier's 'a games COUNT is a season aggregate against a player-WEEK subject' is right about the grain and does not dispose of the audit question. g/gs are real material at season grain with a contracted canonical and no physical column.
adjudications.remedy: route g/gs through the census + demand join (24.4) as season-grain candidates; the audit target must exist before the audit can run

adjudications.v26_col: (no such column -- def_interception_long does not exist)
adjudications.basis: DEMAND EVIDENCE for a new canonical, assembled rather than asserted. v26 carries SEVEN *_long columns -- fg_long, kickoff_return_long, passing_long, punt_long, punt_return_long, receiving_long, rushing_long -- and no defensive one, while holding def_interception_yards and def_int_ret_td. TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES publish the missing statistic and AGREE ON IT: nflcom `lng` vs PFR `def_int_long` is 99.23% EXACT on 12,948 common player-seasons, and no era falls below 98.4% (<1982 98.4 / 1982-93 99.5 / 1994-99 99.8 / 2000-09 99.9 / 2010+ 99.7). A statistic two sources define identically across a century is well defined; the hole is ours.
adjudications.crossed_control: Against nflcom `lng` the PFR SEASON yardage total reads 52.77% where PFR's own long reads 99.23% -- a 46-point margin ruling out the reading that `lng` is just the season total. The residual 52.77% is itself explained: on a season with exactly one interception the long IS the total, and that self-check holds on 98.82% of 4,985 single-interception seasons. The BOUND lng <= season interception return yards holds independently on both sources, 99.13% (nflcom) and 98.97% (PFR) of 15,468.
adjudications.supply: PFR is the better supplier: 89,818 player-seasons carry def_int_long against nflcom's 15,525, so the column could be populated far beyond this table's reach. StatsCrew was recorded in the O.9.3 pass as independently proposing the same missing column, which is a third proposer, not a third measurement -- it is NOT counted as corroboration here.
adjudications.settles: The dossier's NEW_SUPERTABLE_COLUMN_CANDIDATE disposition for `lng` is correct and now carries the evidence a demand join would need.
adjudications.remedy: add def_interception_long (unit=yards, aggregation_class=MAX, mirroring the seven sibling longs) and populate from pfr_player_defense.def_int_long
adjudications.blocker: THE ROUTE THE DISPOSITION NAMES DOES NOT EXIST. Both column_dossier.py and closure_scoreboard.py describe NEW_SUPERTABLE_COLUMN_CANDIDATE as 'routed through the census + demand join (24.4)', but there is no demand-join lane and no counter over the candidates -- the phrase names a process that was never built, so every candidate has been parked in prose. Adding a schema column is also a promote-class change requiring sign-off. Escalated rather than hand-added: 'never hand-add to a schema' is the standing law.

adjudications.basis: STAYS OPEN, but no longer unconstrained. The 2026-07-30 pass proved what `solo` is NOT (COMBINED = SOLO + AST holds on 50.0% against TKL's 100.0%) and never established what it IS. Measured 2026-07-31 against every defensive statistic PFR carries, on 28,4xx-29,4xx common player-seasons from 2000: the best candidate is tackles_solo at 29.07%, against a CONTROL of nflcom `tkl` vs the same column at 76.5%. tackles_combined 11.0, tackles_assists 4.44, qb_hits 1.03, tackles_loss 0.63, pass_defended 0.37, sacks 0.24, def_int 0.04. Nothing fits.
adjudications.crossed_control: POSITIVE STRUCTURE, which is what a future proposal has to satisfy: `solo` is a SUBSET of unassisted tackles. solo <= tkl holds on 99.98% and solo <= combined on 100.00% of 30,654 player-seasons; solo == tkl on 86.83% of seasons where the player recorded NO assists but only 29.53% where he did, and the residual tkl-solo is a non-negative distribution with mode 0. So the missing criterion correlates with assisted plays.
adjudications.refuted_hypotheses: SPECIAL-TEAMS SPLIT REFUTED: if tkl were defence+special-teams and solo defence-only, tkl-solo would be special_teams_tackles_solo -- it matches on 29.52%, and solo == def_tackles_solo - special_teams_tackles_solo on 20.88%, against tkl == def_tackles_solo at 86.70%. Also refuted as a function of the other three published columns: solo == combined-ast 53.42%, == combined 27.82%, == ast 6.43%.
adjudications.settles: Nothing. Recorded so the next attempt starts from the constraints rather than re-running the elimination.
adjudications.remedy: none; `solo` stays OPEN in the dossier. A withdrawal is the ABSENCE of a decision, so no disposition row is written for it.

adjudications.basis: THE KICKER'S PAGE RENDERS THE KICKING SIDE, NOT THE RETURNING SIDE. `ret` sits in a kickoff sub-block (ko / avg / tb / ret / avg_2) whose other members the dossier already types as material v26 lacks -- 'v26 carries kickoff RETURN columns but nothing for the kicking side'. `ret` was mapped to the RETURNER's kickoff_returns by name and is the kicking team's returns ALLOWED.
adjudications.crossed_control: Two controls, opposite directions. (1) The block is placed: nflcom `tb` == PFR `kickoff_tb` on 97.29% of 1,695 kicker-seasons, and 96.2-98.2% in every era -- the sub-block is the kicking side. (2) The mapping is refuted: `ret` == v26.kickoff_returns on 0.00% of 2,112 kicker-seasons where the source is positive, in EVERY era, with medians 30.5 against our 0.0; only 0.33% of those kickers have ANY kickoff return in v26. A kicker does not return kickoffs. Partial support for the reading: ret == PFR (kickoff - touchbacks) exactly on 32.98% and within 2 on 71.03% -- an approximation, not an identity, because out-of-bounds and fair-catch kickoffs are neither returned nor touchbacks, so it is NOT proposed as a mapping.
adjudications.settles: A malformed expression scores near 0 and a right one near 100; 0.00% flat across five eras is the malformed end of that law, not a weak witness.
adjudications.remedy: withdraw ret -> kickoff_returns; the decision row is DELETED so the dossier row returns to OPEN, and mapspec_generator --apply removed the spec
adjudications.remedy_note: `ret` now joins ko/avg/tb/avg_2 as kicking-side material v26 does not carry. It is NOT adjudicated to NEW_SUPERTABLE_COLUMN_CANDIDATE here -- that is an identity decision and the same missing demand-join lane blocks it as blocks def_interception_long.

adjudications.basis: THE MAPPING IS SOUND AND OUR NUMBER IS WRONG -- and unusually, the disagreement GROWS with modernity, which is backwards from every other column on this table. nflcom xp_att vs our pat_att: 90.5% (<1994), 88.9% (1994-2009), 82.3% (2010+). Meanwhile xpm vs pat_made is 99.5-100.0% in every modern era, so we have the MAKES right and the ATTEMPTS wrong.
adjudications.crossed_control: THREE-WAY on 604 kicker-seasons where all three publish, 2010+: nflcom~PFR 100.0%, nflcom~us 82.3%, PFR~us 82.3%. Two sources agree with each other PERFECTLY and disagree with us identically. This is the exact test the tackle-family queued question specified -- there it was REFUTED, here it fires.
adjudications.internal_proof: NO EXTERNAL SOURCE IS NEEDED TO CONVICT US. Our own partition pat_att = pat_made + pat_missed + pat_blocked holds on only 82.44% of 2010+ kicker-seasons and 26.66% before 1994, and 42.14% of 2010+ seasons carry pat_missed = 0 AND pat_blocked = 0 -- after the 2015 rule moved the try to the 15-yard line, misses are common and a 42% never-missed rate is not credible. Same defect class as the return longs: a zero written where nothing was observed.
adjudications.settles: The 2005-2019 licence verdict MAPPING-SUSPECT (0.8195) is a verdict about the MAPPING and is wrong about the party. Recording fault=SUPERTABLE_VALUE keeps the licence, which is the inversion this ledger exists for.
adjudications.remedy: repair pat_missed / pat_blocked, which will re-derive pat_att; promote-class, needs sign-off

adjudications.basis: CLEAN IN THE MODERN ERA, BROKEN BEFORE 1982, and the licence stratum hides it: on 2005-2019 this mapping validates at 1.0000/565, while pre-1982 nflcom fg_att vs our fg_att reads 79.9%. fg_made agrees at 100.0% in BOTH eras, so we have every make and are missing attempts.
adjudications.crossed_control: THREE-WAY on 938 pre-1982 kicker-seasons: nflcom~PFR 99.0%, nflcom~us 79.9%, PFR~us 80.5%, and the residual is ONE-SIDED -- 183 rows where the sources exceed us against 6 the other way. Post-1982 all three sit at 99.9%.
adjudications.internal_proof: Our partition fg_att = fg_made + fg_missed holds at 100.0% in both eras, so fg_att is not independently wrong -- it is being DRAGGED DOWN by fg_missed, which is 0 on 44.73% of pre-1982 kicker-seasons against 4.07% after. Half the pre-1982 kickers are recorded as never missing a field goal, in an era when league FG% was near 55-65%.
adjudications.settles: fg_missed pre-1982 is the fabricated zero; fg_att is its arithmetic consequence. Repair the operand, not the total.
adjudications.remedy: repair pre-1982 fg_missed; fg_att re-derives from the partition. Promote-class.

adjudications.basis: A CANDIDATE FOR MATERIAL WE DO NOT ACTUALLY HOLD. `ko` (kickoffs taken) is typed NEW_SUPERTABLE_COLUMN_CANDIDATE, but it is numeric on 0 of 83,456 K Career rows -- every value is the empty string. The header exists in our capture and the cells never do.
adjudications.crossed_control: Its block-mates ARE published on the same rows: tb 3,141 numeric (1951-2025), ret 3,141, avg 3,140, avg_2 2,224 (1981-2025). So this is not an era gap or a block that failed to capture -- one column of a published block is empty, which is the truncation signature the O.9.0b un-shift left behind (lng/td/40/1st/fum/rate/net_avg/pct were declared lost per layout the same way).
adjudications.settles: Demand evidence for `ko` cannot be built from our capture. PFR publishes `kickoff` and is the supplier if the column is ever added.
adjudications.remedy: re-parse or re-harvest the K block's KO column before treating `ko` as demand evidence; the candidate disposition stands but is unevidenced

adjudications.basis: THE PUNTER'S PAGE RENDERS THE COVERAGE SIDE. Same defect as K Career `ret`, three columns wide, and here it is POSITIVELY identified rather than merely refuted: PFR publishes the coverage-side concept by name as `punt_ret_yds_opp`, and nflcom `rety` == it on 96.19% of 1,940 punter-seasons exact (97.01% within 1) -- 100.0% in both <1982 and 1982-99, 92.8% from 2000. `rety` is punt-return yards ALLOWED, so its block-mates `ret` and `td` are returns and return-TDs allowed. They sit beside tb/oob/dn/in_20/fc/net_yds, which the dossier already types as punt-coverage concepts v26 lacks.
adjudications.crossed_control: Against the RETURNER's columns: ret == v26.punt_returns 0.00%, rety == v26.punt_return_yards 0.81%, on 2,477 punter-seasons where the source is positive; only 2.62% of those punters have ANY punt return of their own in v26. adjudications.basis: THE GRAIN LAW, MEASURED BEFORE ANY SPEC EXISTS. A player-season appears once per (dimension, split_value), so summing across dimensions multiplies it. Against the validated career total for `int`: summing ALL situational rows agrees on 0.46% with a MEDIAN INFLATION OF 7.33x (mean 6.82x). The runbook's prior estimate of 5-6x was low.
adjudications.and_the_dimensions_are_not_partitions: This is the part that would have been missed by just picking one dimension. Several carry a split that OVERLAPS its siblings: Quarters has SIX values including '4th Quarter within 7' (a subset of the 4th), and Game Halves has THREE including 'Last Two Minutes of Half' (a subset of both). Restricting to the true partition lifts Quarters 70.22% -> 95.02% and Game Halves 65.42% -> 94.42%.

adjudications.the_rule: NO DIMENSION reproduces the season total. This source may not be summed to a season witness naively; the aggregation contract must be DECLARED PER DIMENSION, naming which split_values form the partition and excluding the subset splits.

adjudications.basis: EXPOSURE MATERIAL, NOT A WITNESS -- and unlike the Recent Games downgrade this is measured against what the source COULD witness, not against what it happens to be wired to (rule 9, earned by getting exactly this wrong once).
adjudications.test_1_can_it_reproduce_a_season_total: NO. Summing all dimensions inflates 7.33x (0.46% agreement). No single dimension is exact either: best is Field Position at 95.06%, and even Home vs Road -- a true 2-way partition -- reads 89.15% because 3,079 player-seasons carry only one split. Point Differential's 7 values are NESTED (Ahead contains Ahead by 1-8 and Ahead by 9-16), which is why it reads 18.19%; Attempts covers only 2 of 8 layouts and partitions ATTEMPTS not games, so it reads 0.00% and can never reproduce a season.
adjudications.test_2_could_it_witness_an_UNWITNESSED_c: Eight of its column names map (in other sources' dossier rows) to canonicals with NO licence row anywhere: fumble_recovery_own, def_sack_yards, def_completions_allowed, passing_yds_allowed, passing_tds_allowed, rushing_tds_allowed, receiving_tds_allowed, def_explosive_pass_allowed, def_explosive_rush_allowed, passing_int_pct, fg_pct. So the could-witness set is NOT empty -- the Recent Games mistake would have been to stop here and declare redundancy.
adjudications.test_2_measured: own_fr -> fumble_recovery_own, the strongest candidate (a real count with no witness at all), agrees on 28.29% via Home vs Road, 28.32% via Stadium Surfaces, 28.74% via Field Position and 28.54% via Point Differential's {Ahead,Behind,Tied} partition. IDENTICAL across every dimension, which means the grain is not the obstacle -- the values do not correspond. Far below any bar.
adjudications.test_3_does_v26_carry_matching_SPLIT_col: v26's situational-shaped columns are def_rz_plays_faced, def_rz_td_allowed, def_third_down_allowed/_faced, def_fourth_down_allowed/_faced, fourth_down_stop, game_margin, home_away, is_overtime. The red-zone pair is TEAM-DEFENSE FACING the red zone, not a player's own red-zone production, so Field Position|'Opp 19-1' (87,578 rows) has no counterpart. Third/fourth down are not situational dimensions here at all. NOTE: a first pattern sweep returned 133 'matches' and most were half-PPR fantasy formats matching the substring 'half' -- the real overlap is the nine columns named above.
adjudications.ruling: KEEP FOR EXPOSURE, NOT FOR AUDIT. The splits themselves are material v26 does not carry at any grain, which makes them candidate/product surface rather than witnesses. PBP can regenerate and verify them later; that is a derivation lane, not a witness lane. Do NOT write season-grain MapSpecs against this source.
adjudications.what_still_needs_doing_here: The 91 dossier rows still need dispositions -- as candidates or excluded-with-reason, NOT as mappings -- and the eight _lost_column entries need their capture receipt so nothing is ever specced against them.
adjudications.remedy: measure the 40 existing grain-guarded specs and license or refuse on the number; era-gate exposure regardless of that outcome
adjudications.WITHDRAWN_IN_PART: THE RULING 'do NOT write season-grain MapSpecs against this source' IS WITHDRAWN. It contradicted work that already existed, measured, in the file I was about to edit. mapspec_generator's declaration for nflcom_player_situational already carries row_filter="_table='Home vs Road'" with this rationale: 'Home vs Road is partition-valid by measurement: it agrees 98.2-99.5% with Attempts, Stadium Surfaces and Field Position, while Quarters (~44%), Game Halves (~37%), Margin of Victory (49%) and Point Differential (18-28%) fail -- Point Differential last because `Behind` contains `Behind by 1-8` and `Behind by 9-16`, so summing double-counts.' A previous session found the grain problem, measured every dimension, selected the partition-valid one, and documented the nesting. All 40 generated specs carry that filter; nflcom_player_splits likewise carries _table='Months'. STEP 0 failed a SEVENTH time in one session.
adjudications.and_my_loaded_gun_claim_was_wrong: I reported the 40 unvalidated specs as a hazard that would write 7.33x-inflated licence rows if anyone ran the lane. They are row-filtered to ONE partition-valid dimension and cannot inflate. Unvalidated is not unguarded.
adjudications.what_the_two_measurements_actually_say_t: Neither session had the whole picture and they do not conflict. The generator's 98.2-99.5% is dimension-vs-DIMENSION agreement -- internal consistency among the partition-valid cuts. Mine is dimension-vs-TRUTH: Home vs Road summed against the validated career `int` total reads 89.15%, because 3,079 player-seasons carry only one of the two splits. So the cut is internally consistent AND ~11 points short of the season total. That gap is the real finding and is what a licence measurement would land on.
adjudications.ruling_as_corrected: The source CAN be summed to a season witness via a partition-valid dimension, and the machinery to do it already exists and is grain-guarded. What is NOT established is whether the result clears the bar: the expected ceiling is ~89%, not 99.5%. The correct next step is to MEASURE the 40 specs and let the number decide, not to rule the source out. Everything else in this adjudication stands: the 7.33x naive inflation, the nesting of Point Differential, Attempts covering 2 of 8 layouts, the ~28% own_fr result, the absence of a red-zone counterpart, and the era defects (1,100 pre-1966 Turf rows, ~6,200 pre-1978 quarter splits) which still require era-gating for exposure.

adjudications.basis: IT IS AN EQUATION, AND THE THIRD TERM WOULD DOUBLE-COUNT. Joe: 'we def have 2_pt with an alias somewhere. i think we keep passing 2pts and rushing 2pts even.' Correct -- v26 carries THREE: passing_2pt_conversions, rushing_2pt_conversions and receiving_2pt_conversions, all SUM/count. I had reported 'NO v26 COLUMN' after guessing two names instead of searching the schema.
adjudications.the_mirror_is_proven: A two-point pass is ONE team event credited on both the passing and the receiving side. Measured: passing_2pt_conversions == receiving_2pt_conversions on 447 of 447 team-seasons (100.00%), mean 1.66 each. So the team equation is rushing + passing; adding receiving would double every two-point pass.
adjudications.same_shape_as_the_TD_excess: The team-conservation lane reports its only excess-dominated columns as PASS_TD (66) and RECV_TD (76) -- the other mirrored pair. On the rows its CSV emits, the PASS_TD and RECV_TD excess team-seasons are the SAME 5 of 5, which suggests one defect counted twice rather than two. Flagged, not concluded: the CSV holds 55 rows against 89 and 107 flagged in the summary, so that is a sample.
adjudications.fr_td_also_had_an_alias: `fr_td` maps to `fum_ret_td` (SUM, unit=touchdowns, family=fumbles). I had also called that 'NO v26 COLUMN' from the same two-guess mistake. The pts_* columns that matched my search are FANTASY POINTS, not events, and are correctly not candidates.
adjudications.remedy: declare 2_pt as an EQUATION capacity (rushing_2pt + passing_2pt) rather than a mapping; map fr_td -> fum_ret_td

adjudications.basis: ONE FRANCHISE-SEASON SETS THE CEILING ON NEARLY EVERY FAMILY. Joe's diagnostic -- 'compare with 2025 only and if theyre 100% then the issue is either poor atoms or different tails' -- put the 2025 baseline at 31 team-seasons, and ~24 of 49 families landed at EXACTLY 96.8%. That is 30/31 with one short: a single team-season failing almost everything, not per-column noise.
adjudications.the_team: fid=9 in 2025, flagged in 44 of 49 families. The AUTHORITY side is roughly double ours: PASS_YDS authority 7,406 vs ours 3,703 (exactly 2x), PASS_TD 40 vs 19, PASS_CMP 655 vs 332, PASS_INT 18 vs 8.
adjudications.mechanism: PASS_YDS doubling EXACTLY means the authority CTE is summing two nflcom rows onto one franchise -- the lane groups `SUM(col)` by (fid, yr), so if two nicknames resolve to the same fid for that season their totals add. The nflcom_team_fid receipt already warns this is the hazard: it is keyed per (nickname, SEASON) precisely because Texans and Titans each span two franchises. The non-exact ratios on TD/CMP/INT say it is two DIFFERENT rows being summed rather than one row counted twice.
adjudications.what_it_means_for_every_other_number: The realistic clean rate for the ~24 families sitting at 96.8% is 100% once fid=9/2025 is resolved. Reading 96.8% as a quality signal per column would be wrong -- it is one key defect reported 24 times.
adjudications.remedy: resolve the fid=9 2025 key collision in the nflcom_team_fid crosswalk (one franchise resolving two nicknames, or a duplicate source row), then re-run

adjudications.basis: Joe: 'we have these columns so figure it out.' Diagnosed each against alternative expressions and planes instead of guessing. ONE was my mapping error; the other four are OUR COLUMN RUNNING SHORT, which the medians settle rather than the agreement rate.

Sacks are credited per player in HALVES, so an IDP sum loses to rounding while the DEF row carries the official team figure. My plane choice was wrong, not the mapping. adjudications.first_downs_MAPPING_IS_RIGHT_our_column_: nflcom passing/offense `1st` has a 2025 median of 183.5 per team-season. Candidates: passing_first_downs 132.5, rush+rec 217.0, pass+rush+rec 349.5. 183.5 is a plausible team passing-first-down total and 132.5 is not, so the mapping is right and WE HOLD ABOUT 72% OF IT. receiving_first_downs returns the IDENTICAL 132.5, which re-confirms the pass/receive mirror -- one event, two credited sides.
adjudications.why_the_direction_flipped: FD_* reads 30/30 SHORT in 2025 and EXCESS over the full range (600 / 595 / 1,134). Both are true: the modern shortfall is a population gap and the historical excess is something else. One mapping cannot be wrong in two directions, which is why the flip was worth chasing -- it means two defects, and the 2025 half is now identified as ours.
adjudications.rushing_fumbles_short: nflcom rush_fum median 5.0; rushing_fumbles 3.5, fumbles 15.5, fumbles_lost 7.0. rushing_fumbles is the closest of three and still short -- so the mapping stands and the column under-counts. 26.7% exact in 2025.
adjudications.two_point_short_in_2025_only: nflcom 2_pt median 1.5; rush+pass 1.0 and rush+rec 1.0 both at 70.0%, while rush+pass+rec gives 2.0 at 26.7%. The tie between the two two-term forms and the failure of the three-term form re-confirms the mirror a third time. Full range is 97.0%, so the 2025 shortfall is current-season incompleteness on our side, not a mapping fault.
adjudications.punt_blocks_low_signal: p_blk median 0.0 and punts_blocked median 0.0 -- the column is almost entirely zeros, so 56.7% exact carries little information either way. def_blk_kick (median 1.5) is WORSE at 26.7%, and it is NULL on the DEF row. The flag loop skips a team-season whose authority is ZERO -- it must, because a relative tolerance against 0 is 0 -- but the skipped row stayed in the denominator, so pct_clean was partly a measure of how RARE a stat is rather than how well it reconciles. The gap was ~2,000 zero-authority rows voting clean. The real base is 44 franchise-seasons -- NFL.com records a made 60-yarder in only 44 of them -- and on those 44 it is 44/44.

adjudications.basis: THE MAPPING IS RIGHT AND THE COLUMN IS 80% EMPTY. KRET_LNG 27.8% and PRET_LNG 27.4% clean, and EVERY SINGLE failure is SHORT with zero excess (1,129 and 1,100 of them). adjudications.measured: kickoff_return_long is > 0 on 10,699 of the 52,579 weekly rows that carry kickoff_returns > 0 -- 41,863 return-weeks record a return and no long. punt_return_long: 7,780 of 34,747. adjudications.second_defect_found_beside_it: 3,339 of the 4,804 player-seasons with 4+ return weeks carry a CONSTANT long across every week -- the weekly column is frequently the SEASON long stamped onto each week, not a per-week maximum. Harmless under MAX and catastrophic under SUM, which is the same class of error as the 4,407 impossible values: an aggregation class asserted rather than derived.
adjudications.not_a_candidate: The four own-side longs that ARE populated (passing 95.9%, rushing 97.1%, receiving 97.3%, fg 97.3%) prove the MAX law and the (franchise, season) key both work for this class, so these two are a backfill, not a definition question.
adjudications.remedy: backfill kickoff_return_long and punt_return_long from PBP return events; separately decide whether the weekly column should hold the week's maximum

adjudications.basis: THE COMPOSITE CELL PUBLISHES TWO FACTS AND ONLY ONE OF THEM RECONCILES. made == fg_made_X measures 94-100% per bucket; att == fg_made_X + fg_missed_X measures 34-80% and runs SHORT in the great majority (40-49 yards: 1,377 of 2,101 short, median authority 8 attempts against our 5). So fg_missed_* does not complete the attempt total.
adjudications.why_it_is_filed_as_a_gap_not_a_definitio: Blocked kicks would explain a small residue, not a median of 3 missing attempts in the 40-49 bucket. The shortfall also GROWS with distance (80.5% at 1-19 down to 34.2% at 40-49), which fits a partially populated miss column rather than a boundary disagreement -- a boundary error would move attempts BETWEEN adjacent buckets and show excess somewhere.
adjudications.the_mechanism_note_that_matters_more: This is wired at all only because THE LANE BUILDS ITS OWN SQL. The same six columns were WITHDRAWN as premature closures earlier in the program because MapSpec.value_path and MapSpec.transform are DECLARED AND INERT -- a composite mapping there emits a spec measuring zero rows while reading as mapped. The blocker was never the composite cell; it was the vehicle.
adjudications.remedy: backfill fg_missed_* per distance bucket, then re-measure the attempt half as a second witness on the same cell

adjudications.basis: THE LANE WAS NOT REPRODUCIBLE. adjudications.remedy: deterministic tie-break committed

adjudications.basis: THE WORST FAMILY IN THE SOURCE (42.3% clean, 1,204 of 1,212 failures EXCESS) WAS A GROSS-VERSUS-NET MISMATCH. NFL.com's passing/defense `yds` is NET of sack yards; it was mapped to passing_yds_allowed, which is gross. Our number is therefore larger, which is exactly the one-sided excess observed.
adjudications.the_source_disagrees_with_itself_and_tha: receiving/defense also publishes `yds`, and the two columns differ on 1,236 of 2,228 team-seasons with a MEDIAN GAP OF 165 YARDS -- a season's worth of sack yardage. The 992 pairs that are IDENTICAL are the years before sack yardage was recorded (sacks became official in 1982), which confirms the interpretation rather than merely permitting it.
adjudications.why_it_went_unseen_for_so_long: Only one of the two columns had ever been wired. Measuring receiving/defense.yds against the SAME canonical returned 99.1% where this one returned 42.3%, and a 57-point spread between two source columns claiming the same quantity IS the finding. The spread only becomes visible when both are measured.
adjudications.this_retires_an_earlier_ruling: An earlier adjudication in this program recorded that the 42% was a pre-1978 tail and that the SACK-YARDS HYPOTHESIS WAS REFUTED on a median difference of 0.0. That comparison was against the wrong pair. The difference is 165. The refutation is withdrawn.
adjudications.measured_correction: passing_yds_allowed - def_sack_yards gives 60.6% and flips 1,204 excess into 814 short. Directionally right and overshooting, because def_sack_yards is itself era-limited -- so the residual belongs to that column's coverage, not to this mapping. The clean form wants a net_passing_yds_allowed canonical.
adjudications.remedy: wired to the net expression (60.6%); backfill def_sack_yards pre-1982 or add net_passing_yds_allowed, then re-measure

RULING REVERSED BY ITS OWN RE-VOUCH (2026-08-03), the escalation gate working as built. The computed solo+ast lane was implemented via source_expr and measured on 2024 against the post-batch-5 plane: Regular Season 0.7356 (n=9179), Post Season 0.2384 (n=365), Preseason 0.3524, situational L0 0.1695 (n=1221), splits L0 0.1735 (n=1199) -- while raw `total` holds its 0.9995 lock. RECONCILIATION: our tackle family derives from pbp tackle-credit arrays over EVERY play type including special teams, and nflcom gamelog `total` also counts all phases -- that is why they match at 0.9995. nflcom solo/ast are defense-phase-only, which is why nflcom's own total != solo+ast on ~49% of rows AND why computed solo+ast cannot reproduce our combined. The internal-identity failure was real; the inference from it was backwards. VERDICT: total -> def_tackles_combined STANDS (empirically vouched); nflcom solo/ast may only witness phase-scoped concepts, never our all-phase combined. DEFINITION note: our def_tackles_* columns are ALL-PHASES (defense + special teams), internally coherent (combined==solo+assists 18661/18661 at 2024).

measurement_law: An agree_pct is only worth its NON-ZERO base. nflcom `sfty` reads 98.5% on rows that are 99.0% zero-vs-zero -- it agrees about nothing -- while `solo` reads 51.9% on a base only 3.0% zero and is a real disagreement. Every rate recorded here carries its zero share and the two medians. An absolute tolerance is also magnitude-blind: +/-1 against a median of 5 is a different test than +/-1 against a median of 573, so a family whose columns differ in magnitude cannot be ranked on one tolerance.
